prompt:
We're kicking off Sprint 14 and need to bootstrap the project's task tracker. All tracker data must live inside the `project_notes/` folder at the root of the workspace — not anywhere else on the system.

Please read the file `sprint14_setup.txt` in the workspace root. It lists exactly which tasks to register, which urgency levels to apply to which tasks, which tasks have been completed and should be closed out, and the name of the export file to produce.

The export file (`sprint14_export.txt`) should end up inside `project_notes/` and contain only the tasks that are still active after the completed ones have been removed.
